info.text:
Nvidia's share price fell 90% in a weekend. Nobody lost anything.
It was a 10-for-1 split: the June 7, 2024 close of $1,208.88 became $120.88 per share, with 10x the shares (split-adjusted trading began June 10, 2024).
Our math: 1 share at $1,000 = 10 shares at $100 = still $1,000.
From its 1980 IPO to 2020, Apple split 5 times (1987, 2000, 2005, 2014, 2020): 1 original share became 224 shares. A reverse split goes the other way, like Citigroup's 1-for-10 in May 2011.
Sources: FINRA and Investor.gov (stock split definitions); Fortune and Nasdaq (Nvidia, June 2024); Apple split history via Yahoo Finance and Motley Fool; Citigroup 8-K (May 2011).
News and education, not financial advice.
